tagline: AWS CLI command suggestions and execution — every call runs against your account, so nothing is allowed by default.
requirements: Configure AWS credentials on the host (AWS_PROFILE or the standard chain). This is the official AWS Labs server; call_aws executes real AWS CLI commands with the host's credentials, so every call requires explicit approval.

tools.name: suggest_aws_commands
tools.note: Suggests AWS CLI commands for a natural-language request — suggestions only, nothing executes.

tools.name: call_aws
tools.note: Executes an AWS CLI command with the host's credentials. Can read, modify, or delete anything the credentials allow.

seo.description: Share the official AWS API MCP server with MCPWire. Starts with every tool denied — approve each AWS CLI call individually, or allow suggest_aws_commands for read-safe planning.
